channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-101351 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 1.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 1.9 | LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. Parts of a crafted image could be left unwritten, so leftover memory became part of the imported image and could be saved with the document. In fixed versions the pixels of a new image start out cleared, so any part the image data does not fill is blank.

item.title: CVE-2026-101352 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.

item.title: CVE-2026-101353 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. In fixed versions the files of an embedded database are kept in a private location, and an embedded database cannot create table files anywhere else.

item.title: CVE-2026-101892 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.

item.title: CVE-2026-101929 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. When a value in the compiled form used an older record format, it could be read as a different type from the one the existing value held, which corrupted memory. In fixed versions the existing value is cleared before a value in the older format is read.

item.title: CVE-2026-101930 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to these events were not taken into account by the macro security check, so they could run when the document was opened, whatever the macro security level. In fixed versions these macros follow the macro security settings like any other macro in the document.

item.title: CVE-2026-101933 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. An out-of-bounds write existed when the compiled form was read, because the positions of its strings were not checked against the size of the data they refer to, and a type found by name was not checked to be of the right kind. In fixed versions these positions are checked, a library that fails the check is not loaded, and a type of the wrong kind is ignored.

item.title: CVE-2026-104007 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.

item.title: CVE-2026-104692 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.

item.title: CVE-2026-104920 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

item.title: CVE-2026-104933 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.7 | LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

item.title: CVE-2026-106535 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a crafted VSDX file contained a malformed path from one part of the drawing to another. In fixed versions a malformed path is handled without writing outside its data.

item.title: CVE-2026-108169 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.

item.title: CVE-2026-113630 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.8
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.8 | Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows a local attacker with command execution as the ds user to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted --hash argument that is interpolated unvalidated into a GNU sed expression, where the sed e flag runs attacker-controlled commands. The packaged sudoers policy permits ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.

item.title: CVE-2026-113631 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows an authenticated view-only user to export a reconstructed copy of a document, including content the viewer never displayed such as custom XML, custom document properties and field instruction text, even when download and form-filling are disabled. The attacker reconnects with a valid Session JWT while substituting an attacker-controlled callback URL, which the Session JWT does not bind, then invokes sendForm over RPC, causing DocumentServer to send the reconstructed DOCX to that URL.

item.title: CVE-2026-129235 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the download_file tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go accepts caller-controlled path and dest values, fetches a selected Kubeshark Hub API response, and writes the returned bytes through os.Create(dest) in callDownloadFile without confining the destination. An attacker who influences arguments through an AI agent driving kubeshark mcp can write Hub-supplied bytes to any path writable by the local MCP user and can read captured network traffic from default auth-disabled Hub deployments. The tool is registered without --allow-destructive; reliable code execution is not demonstrated because the bytes are constrained to Hub API responses. Hub-side default authentication remains outside this remediation, so captured traffic can remain readable in default auth-disabled Hub deployments after the local destination-write fix. The destination-write issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-129236 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the start_kubeshark MCP tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go uses callStartKubeshark to append caller-controlled pod_regex as a bare positional argument to kubeshark tap without a -- end-of-options separator, allowing a value beginning with --set to be parsed as a Helm value override. An attacker who influences tool arguments against kubeshark mcp --allow-destructive can redirect the privileged worker, Hub, and front images through tap.docker.registry and tap.docker.tag to an attacker-controlled registry. Because the deployed worker DaemonSet runs privileged with host networking and host filesystem access, a malicious image can obtain node and cluster-admin access when the host already has permission to deploy it. This issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-129237 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.41, the unpackTar extraction logic in app/utils/tar.go validates cleaned archive entry paths with strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, destdirClean) without enforcing a path-separator boundary. When UseContext enables the Docker Compose build context path in app/configuration/bundle_docker_compose.go, a less-privileged archive supplier with delegated configuration and/or file-manager access can provide a sibling-prefix traversal entry that passes the check, causing utils.UnpackTar to create directories and regular files outside the intended context extraction directory with qbee-agent process privileges, despite the supplier lacking authority to write those sibling files. In deployments where only full device or fleet administrators can provide Docker Compose context archives, this behavior is hardening rather than a crossed security boundary. The demonstrated impact is limited to nearby cache or project paths sharing the destination prefix, may affect integrity or availability of qbee-agent-managed Docker Compose state, and does not establish arbitrary absolute-path writes or direct code execution. This issue is fixed in version 2026.41.

item.title: CVE-2026-129239 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Directus is a real-time API and App dashboard for managing SQL database content. Prior to 12.3.1, Directus allows an authenticated non-admin with update permission on directus_shares to modify user_created, role, item, and collection on an existing owned share because authorization checks the pre-update row and does not revalidate the merged row. The update path does not force user_created to the acting user or rerun share access checks when item or collection changes. Setting user_created and role to administrator identifiers causes guest share authentication to derive administrator accountability from both fields, exposing data reachable from the shared item beyond the owner and share role permissions. The issue requires update permission on directus_shares, an item the account can share, and knowledge of administrator user and role identifiers, and it does not issue an administrator token or provide write or availability impact. This issue is fixed in version 12.3.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-18563 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

item.title: CVE-2026-18564 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-18565 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 1.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 1.1 | LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

item.title: CVE-2026-18566 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

item.title: CVE-2026-64890 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description:
Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | : Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information vulnerability in Johnson Controls Open Blue Companion Android App on Android allows : Retrieve Embedded Secrets from Software.
This issue affects Open Blue Companion Android App: before R2.22.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-84234 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mask, are converted along the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when an image with a transparency mask was converted, because positions taken from a crafted image were not checked against the size of the image buffer. In fixed versions the image size is limited, and the position of each mask pixel is checked before it is written.

item.title: CVE-2026-84443 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so opening or converting a crafted database document could run a macro and, through it, any command. In fixed versions macros bound to the events of a Base document follow the macro security setting, as macros in other documents do.

item.title: CVE-2026-86046 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1 | termux-sync is an open source tool for backing up and restoring a Termux environment across devices. Prior to 1.2.4, termux-sync restore uses the parent directory of the untrusted manifest.json files.*.source value as an extraction destination, and extract_archive calls tarfile.extract on archive members without enforcing a destination boundary. A victim who restores a malicious or tampered backup from local, shared, GitHub, or Google Drive storage can have files written anywhere the Termux user can write, including shell startup files or executable scripts that can lead to code execution when later used. The restore path also accepts unsafe backup_name values for temporary paths, and archive members are not constrained to the intended destination. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-87932 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current values when the document is exported, including in a conversion run from the command line. Values taken from the document were not escaped where they were used, so a crafted document could write a file of its choosing anywhere the user can write when it was exported to DOCX. In fixed versions these values are written into the document directly, and the XSLT transformations LibreOffice runs can no longer write files or use the network.

item.title: CVE-2026-88987 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove script-capable XHTML and XML data URIs from stored CMS content. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-88988 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove SVG data URIs from stored CMS content even though SVG documents can execute script. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-88989 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form can send a direct save request that creates a new record even when the user does not have permission to create that record type. The server-side save path checks edit access but does not enforce the required create permission before persistence. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-91110 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not normalize certain control bytes that browsers ignore when parsing URLs. A CMS author can place those bytes before a javascript: URL in stored content so the sanitiser misses the dangerous scheme, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views the content. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-91112 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a user with CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin but without ADMIN can edit or reparent a group that grants ADMIN-equivalent permissions through an assigned role or a parent group, thereby escalating to full administrative privileges. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-91113 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form can submit a user-controlled ClassName value to change the record into an unrelated class without the create and edit permission checks required for that target class. This permits an unauthorized record type change outside the GridField's intended model hierarchy. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-91114 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.4 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, PermissionCheckboxSetField accepts permission codes that the field did not offer and stores them without an allowlist, then renders permission codes without escaping them. A user with access to the Security section can save attacker-controlled content as a permission code, causing JavaScript to execute in the browser of another user who views the field. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-91115 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.13, the writer option of i18nTextCollectorTask is passed to the dependency injector without validating that it names an allowed writer implementation. A crafted dev task URL can therefore instantiate arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and execute code on the server. An administrator can be induced to run the task by following a link because the nested task did not require confirmation, and a site in dev mode exposes the path without authentication. CMS 5 is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-97892 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size of the file. In fixed versions a signature that claims to cover anything outside the file is reported as not valid.

item.title: CVE-2026-97894 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line could be copied into the imported document. In fixed versions each line is read up to its limit and no further.

item.title: CVE-2026-97999 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the migration, because a value could be longer than the space set aside for its column. In fixed versions that space is enlarged whenever a value is longer than its column.

item.title: CVE-2026-98100 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken only from the picture data.
